headlines.title: Supreme Court set to pare back federal inmates’ ability to sue officials
headlines.description: The Supreme Court appears likely to bar prison inmates from suing government officials who deny them medical treatment.

headlines.title: Democratic lawmakers seek to restore deportation protections to Afghans in the U.S.
headlines.description: A pair of House Democrats will try to bypass Republican leaders and force a vote to restore Temporary Protected Status to Afghan nationals in the United States by introducing a discharge petition when Congress returns Monday night.

headlines.title: Tied Minnesota Mayor Election to Be Decided by Random Drawing
headlines.description: A Minnesota mayoral election will be decided by a random drawing after two candidates received exactly the same number of votes. On Monday, Spring Lake Park city officials will draw the name of either incumbent Robert Nelson or challenger Halyn Roth out of a bag to decide who wins the seat.

headlines.title: Nvidia Announces Investigation Into CEO Over Ties to Chinese Spy
headlines.description: AI powerhouse Nvidia is investigating its CEO and co-founder Jensen Huang after he admitted to having an affair with a woman U.S. intelligence officials are calling a Chinese spy. President Donald Trump defended Huang, who is a close ally and advisor to the president, calling him a "fine person" who's "done an amazing job for our country." NBC's Brian Cheung reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Trump Blames Midterm Losses on Immigration: 'It Was Too Tough'
headlines.description: In a "60 Minutes" interview on Sunday, President Donald Trump reflected on the historic midterm election results, acknowledging his deportation policy went too far, saying "It was too tough. I think it might be too tough." NBC's Ryan Nobles reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Early midterm voting data shows enthusiasm ahead of election day
headlines.description: With millions of Americans having already voted, NBC News Director of Elections John Lapinski analyzes early midterm voting data and key races to watch on election night.

headlines.title: Slotkin lawyer warns Blanche not to obey Trump’s ‘frivolous’ demand to investigate her
headlines.description: Donald Trump told the DOJ to investigate Elissa Slotkin. Her lawyer is lawyer warns Todd Blanche not to obey.

headlines.title: Joe Biden to scale back book tour as cancer ‘slows me down’
headlines.description: Former President Joe Biden said his tour to promote his presidential memoir “Promise me, America,” will be scaled back, as he continues to battle cancer.

headlines.title: Trump says he was ‘only kidding’ about making UFC head Dana White press secretary
headlines.description: The president suggested on Truth Social that White should bring several UFC fighters as assistants.

headlines.title: Trump says deportations were ‘too tough’ and hurt him in midterms
headlines.description: The president said in an interview with CBS’ “60 Minutes” that he would like to work out a deal with Democrats on immigration.

headlines.title: Hakeem Jeffries says he’s a ‘hard yes’ on impeaching Pete Hegseth
headlines.description: Jeffries said on ABC’s “This Week” that he supports Rep. Thomas Massie, R-Ky., in his efforts to impeach Hegseth.
